shots.name: Carrying Charmander to the Center
shots.text: Your first Pokemon battle ends with you carrying Charmander into a Pokemon Center. The trainer who beat you is already on his way to the next town. You're holding your partner's tail clear of your jacket, trying to remember whether its flame looked this small before the fight. You wanted eight badges and a shot at the Kanto League. But right now, you'd settle for Charmander opening its eyes. That trip to the Champion starts here, with you waiting outside the treatment room.

shots.name: The nurse checks Charmander
shots.text: The nurse takes Charmander from your arms and asks what happened. You explain the battle against Squirtle, the water attack, and the command you gave after Charmander stumbled. She asks why you didn't call it back. You have an answer ready about getting through the opponent's defenses. It sounds ridiculous while she checks your Pokemon. She takes it through the doorway, and you sit down with an unused Potion in your pocket. You packed it that morning. You forgot it existed when someone challenged you.

shots.name: Waiting with the route map
shots.text: Through the waiting-room window, you can see the road leaving Viridian City. Other trainers pass with partners walking beside them. Your map is spread across your knees, with Pewter City circled. You were supposed to get there before your rival, Milo. Eventually, the nurse comes back. Charmander will recover. You get to bring it home with you, and she suggests learning when to stop a battle before starting another one. Charmander reaches for your sleeve when you pick it up. You stay until it can walk without leaning against your leg.
